## 2 · Assess
When a Google Form response lands in the sheet, each vendor gets three web searches, then the AI model scores them against the GRC doc. The weighted score and tier are computed in **Score against GRC** from the weights in the doc. The result goes to **Assessments** with status *pending_review*, and the approver gets an email.
